scenes.title: Step of three
scenes.problem: Step of three: the first terms are 4, 7, 10, 13. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 4, 7, 10, 13 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference 3, 3, 3.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; 4 + 3 = 7, 7 + 3 = 10, 10 + 3 = 13, so the next term is 16.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 16.

scenes.title: Descending by four
scenes.problem: Descending by four: the first terms are 19, 15, 11, 7. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 19, 15, 11, 7 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference -4, -4, -4.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; Each adjacent change is −4; 7 − 4 = 3.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 3.

scenes.title: Negative start
scenes.problem: Negative start: the first terms are -5, -2, 1, 4. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values -5, -2, 1, 4 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference 3, 3, 3.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; The differences are +3 even across zero; 4 + 3 = 7.
Check against all six given values; the next value at position 7 is 7.
scenes.memo: The differences are +3 even across zero; 4 + 3 = 7.

scenes.title: Even square numbers
scenes.problem: Even square numbers: the first terms are 2, 8, 18, 32. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 2, 8, 18, 32 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference 6, 10, 14.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; These are 2 × 1², 2 × 2², 2 × 3², 2 × 4²; next is 2 × 5² = 50.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 50.

scenes.title: Doubling
scenes.problem: Doubling: the first terms are 3, 6, 12, 24. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 3, 6, 12, 24 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Compare the position, multiplication and alternating paths using the given values.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; Each term doubles; 24 × 2 = 48.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 48.

scenes.title: Halving
scenes.problem: Halving: the first terms are 80, 40, 20, 10. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 80, 40, 20, 10 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Compare the position, multiplication and alternating paths using the given values.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; Each term is half the previous term; 10 ÷ 2 = 5.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 5.
scenes.memo: Each term is half the previous term; 10 ÷ 2 = 5.

scenes.title: Growing squares
scenes.problem: Growing squares: the first terms are 1, 4, 9, 16. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 1, 4, 9, 16 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference 3, 5, 7.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; Term n is n²; 5² = 25. The first differences 3, 5, 7, 9 are not constant.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 25.
scenes.memo: Term n is n²; 5² = 25. The first differences 3, 5, 7, 9 are not constant.

scenes.title: Triangular totals
scenes.problem: Triangular totals: the first terms are 1, 3, 6, 10. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 1, 3, 6, 10 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference 2, 3, 4.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; Add 2, then 3, then 4; the next increase is 5, giving 15.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 15.
scenes.memo: Add 2, then 3, then 4; the next increase is 5, giving 15.

scenes.title: Alternating signed values
scenes.problem: Alternating signed values: the first terms are 2, -4, 8, -16. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 2, -4, 8, -16 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Compare the position, multiplication and alternating paths using the given values.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; Multiply by −2 each time: −16 × −2 = 32.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 32.

scenes.title: Square plus one
scenes.problem: Square plus one: the first terms are 2, 5, 10, 17. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 2, 5, 10, 17 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference 3, 5, 7.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; The rule n² + 1 gives 1²+1, 2²+1, 3²+1, 4²+1; 5²+1 = 26.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 26.

scenes.title: Odd numbers around zero
scenes.problem: Odd numbers around zero: the first terms are -7, -3, 1, 5. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values -7, -3, 1, 5 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference 4, 4, 4.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; The difference remains +4. The sign change does not change the rule.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 9.
scenes.memo: The difference remains +4. The sign change does not change the rule.

scenes.title: Cubes
scenes.problem: Cubes: the first terms are 1, 8, 27, 64. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 1, 8, 27, 64 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference 7, 19, 37.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; Term n is n³; 5³ = 125. A constant-difference rule is false.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 125.
scenes.memo: Term n is n³; 5³ = 125. A constant-difference rule is false.

scenes.title: Square differences
scenes.problem: Square differences: the first terms are 3, 6, 11, 18. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 3, 6, 11, 18 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Mark each successive difference 3, 5, 7.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; The first differences are 3, 5, 7; the next difference is 9. Hence 18+9=27 (n²+2).
Check against the original four values; the next value is 27.
scenes.memo: The first differences are 3, 5, 7; the next difference is 9. Hence 18+9=27 (n²+2).

scenes.title: Ratio then offset
scenes.problem: Ratio then offset: the first terms are 5, 11, 23, 47. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 5, 11, 23, 47 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Compare the position, multiplication and alternating paths using the given values.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; Each term doubles then adds 1; 47×2+1=95. The differences are 6,12,24.
Check against the original four values; the next value is 95.
scenes.memo: Each term doubles then adds 1; 47×2+1=95. The differences are 6,12,24.

scenes.title: Two interleaved paths
scenes.problem: Two interleaved paths: the first terms are 1, 10, 3, 20, 5, 30. Find the next term and justify the rule with the diagram.
actions: Read the given values 1, 10, 3, 20, 5, 30 in order; do not treat the next term as given.
Compare the position, multiplication and alternating paths using the given values.
Choose a rule that works at every given position; Odd positions are 1,3,5,7; even positions are 10,20,30. Next is 7.
Check against all six given values; the next value at position 7 is 7.
scenes.memo: Odd positions are 1,3,5,7; even positions are 10,20,30. Next is 7.
